parent_channels.name: Covering, Disclosure, and Surface Legibility

subchannels.name: Night as an Enveloping Cover
subchannels.scene_or_process: Darkness advances over a field as a layer that conceals what had been visible.
subchannels.active_motifs: night and darkness `ل ي ل:B001/m01`; covering layer over sight or surface `غ ش و:B001/m01`, `غ ش ي:B001/m01`; encompassing cover `غ ش و:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Night supplies the dark setting, while covering supplies the operation by which visibility is progressively overtaken.

subchannels.name: Daybreak as Unveiling
subchannels.scene_or_process: Day opens, darkness recedes, and the face of time becomes bright and manifest.
subchannels.active_motifs: daylight opening `ن ه ر:B002/m01`; disclosure after concealment `ج ل و:B001/m01`; clear white spread of day `ج ل و:B007/m01`; emitted light `ن و ر:B001/m01`; opening face of day `و ج ه:B007/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 92:2 (`ن ه ر`: `النهار`; `ج ل و`: `تجلى`); 92:14 (`ن و ر`: `نارا`); 92:20 (`و ج ه`: `وجه`)
subchannels.synthesis: Disclosure clears the field, light fills it, and the day's exposed front replaces the night's cover.

subchannels.name: Visible Mark, Beacon, and Orientation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A surface is visibly marked or elevated so that an observer can recognize it and orient by it.
subchannels.active_motifs: white marking over an animal's face `غ ش و:B007/m01`, `غ ش ي:B008/m01`; conspicuous route beacon `ن و ر:B005/m01`; front presented to an observer `و ج ه:B001/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Facial whiteness supplies a readable mark, the presented front gives it an orientation, and the beacon scales visible recognition into route guidance.

subchannels.name: Double-Faced and Deceptive Surfaces
subchannels.scene_or_process: An outward face presents one condition while concealing a different interior or material state.
subchannels.active_motifs: person or object with two faces `و ج ه:B015/m01`; hypocritical double-facing `و ج ه:B015/m02`; multicolored cloth that misstates its condition `ك ذ ب:B009/m01`; worn surface beneath appearance `خ ل ق:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The visible face becomes an interface of deception when color or presentation no longer corresponds to the concealed condition.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A field or surface changes according to whether it is covered, exposed, clarified, marked, or made misleading to sight.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 92:1 joins night with covering in `الليل` and `يغشى`, and 92:2 answers with day and disclosure in `النهار` and `تجلى`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Visibility extends into animal facial markings, route beacons, and surfaces whose outward appearance conceals their condition.

subchannels.name: First, Last, and Unbroken Succession
subchannels.scene_or_process: A series begins with a leading member, continues without interruption, and reaches a later or final member.
subchannels.active_motifs: beginning and precedence `ء و ل:B001/m01`; lastness after the first `ء خ ر:B001/m01`; foremost guide `ه د ي:B003/m01`; uninterrupted succession `و ل ي:B002/m01`; entitlement by priority `و ل ي:B008/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 92:13 (`ء و ل`: `الأولى`; `ء خ ر`: `الآخرة`); 92:12 (`ه د ي`: `الهدى`); 92:16 (`و ل ي`: `تولى`)
subchannels.synthesis: Precedence opens the series, the guide occupies its front, succession carries it onward, and lastness closes it.

subchannels.name: Delay, Promptness, and Deferred Transfer
subchannels.scene_or_process: An expected act either occurs without waiting or is postponed into a later transaction.
subchannels.active_motifs: delay to a later time `ء خ ر:B002/m01`; acting without lingering `ك ذ ب:B005/m01`; readiness for an act `ء ت ي:B003/m04`; deferred resale `و ل ي:B014/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Readiness and promptness compress the interval before action, while deferment and resale relocate completion to a later time.

subchannels.name: Return, Interpretation, and Realized Outcome
subchannels.scene_or_process: An affair is returned to its import and judged by the event in which its promise or meaning culminates.
subchannels.active_motifs: return to a final state `ء و ل:B002/m01`; interpretation by final import `ء و ل:B002/m02`; realization of promise or prediction `ص د ق:B004/m01`; sound reading of an affair `و ج ه:B008/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Interpretation identifies what speech leads to, and fulfillment makes that final import visible as an event.

subchannels.name: Night Activity and Temporal Deixis
subchannels.scene_or_process: Action is situated within the night, while "tonight" locates the nearest night relative to the speaker's present.
subchannels.active_motifs: undertaking or travel by night `ل ي ل:B002/m01`; entry into nighttime `ل ي ل:B002/m02`; the night nearest the present day `ل ي ل:B003/m01`; daylight as its temporal opposite `ن ه ر:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Night functions both as a setting for action and as a deictic interval defined against the present day.

subchannels.name: Emergence, Cessation, and Withering
subchannels.scene_or_process: Produce or milk appears and grows, then ceases, dries, or passes out of its productive phase.
subchannels.active_motifs: emerging crop or palm yield `ء ت ي:B007/m01`; organic increase `ز ك و:B001/m01`; milk that unexpectedly ceases `ك ذ ب:B006/m01`; ripe produce beginning to wither `و ل ي:B016/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Emergence and increase form the productive phase, while failed duration and withering form its terminal reversal.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Events acquire order through beginning, succession, delay, promptness, culmination, and the transition from emergence to cessation.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 92:1-2 alternate night and day, 92:13 juxtaposes first and last, and 92:16 presents a decisive turning away.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Temporal order reaches tonight-deixis, delayed resale, immediate action, milk cessation, crop withering, and interpretation by final outcome.

parent_channels.name: Route, Orientation, and Turning

subchannels.name: Road, Junction, and Proper Approach
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveler enters a traversable road from an appropriate side and chooses a course at its junction.
subchannels.active_motifs: course or bearing `ه د ي:B002/m01`; route and intended direction `و ج ه:B002/m01`; traveled road `ء ت ي:B010/m01`; road junction `ء ت ي:B010/m02`; approach from the proper side `ء ت ي:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The road supplies the traversable space, the junction creates choice, and guidance selects the proper approach and bearing.

subchannels.name: Front, Side, Rear, Upper, and Left
subchannels.scene_or_process: A body or object is mapped through a stable coordinate frame used to locate movement and relation.
subchannels.active_motifs: face or front `و ج ه:B001/m01`; side or flank `ج ن ب:B001/m02`; rear or hindpart `ء خ ر:B003/m01`; upper direction `ع ل و:B005/m01`; left side `ع س ر:B005/m01`; leftward direction `ي س ر:B004/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 92:20 (`و ج ه`: `وجه`; `ع ل و`: `الأعلى`); 92:17 (`ج ن ب`: `سيجنبها`); 92:13 (`ء خ ر`: `الآخرة`); 92:10 (`ع س ر`: `العسرى`; `ي س ر`: `نيسره`)
subchannels.synthesis: Front, rear, side, height, and laterality form one coordinate system for describing bodies, objects, and courses.

subchannels.name: Facing, Turning Away, and Repulse
subchannels.scene_or_process: A participant faces a target, turns toward or away from it, or actively drives an approaching party back.
subchannels.active_motifs: face-to-face encounter `و ج ه:B003/m01`; turning toward a target `و ل ي:B006/m01`; turning away `و ل ي:B007/m01`; repelling an arrival `و ج ه:B014/m01`; decisive penetration or effectiveness `ء ت ي:B013/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Facing establishes engagement, turning changes the relation, and repulse makes that reversal an imposed outcome.

subchannels.name: Guidance by Beacon and Visible Course
subchannels.scene_or_process: A raised visible sign identifies a course and lets a traveler maintain direction.
subchannels.active_motifs: gentle guidance to a way `ه د ي:B001/m01`; route beacon or boundary marker `ن و ر:B005/m01`; intended direction `و ج ه:B002/m01`; traveled thoroughfare `ء ت ي:B010/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The beacon makes the route perceptible, guidance relates the traveler to it, and the visible course sustains directed movement.

subchannels.name: Alignment, Lateral Deviation, and Separation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A participant leaves a common line, moves into a side position, and increases the distance from the former route or group.
subchannels.active_motifs: lateral deviation from road or group `ع ن د:B002/m01`; widening distance between two things `ش ت ت:B003/m01`; leftward course `ي س ر:B004/m02`; side position `ج ن ب:B001/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: Deviation breaks alignment, side placement gives the new course a direction, and increasing distance converts a momentary turn into separation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A participant locates and follows a course through routes, axes, facing, directional signs, and reversals of approach.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 92:12 names guidance, 92:16 turns away, and 92:20 seeks a face as its governing direction.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Orientation includes junctions, front-rear and upper-left axes, face-level thrusts, repulse, and road markers.

parent_channels.name: Endeavor, Fitness, and Resistance

subchannels.name: Divergent Work and Purposeful Exertion
subchannels.scene_or_process: Participants direct effort toward different aims, producing distinct kinds and outcomes of work.
subchannels.active_motifs: work and earning `س ع ي:B002/m01`; purposeful exertion `س ع ي:B002/m03`; divergent kinds and intentions `ش ت ت:B001/m02`; seeking a desired end `ب غ ي:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 92:4 (`س ع ي`: `سعيكم`; `ش ت ت`: `شتى`); 92:20 (`ب غ ي`: `ابتغاء`)
subchannels.synthesis: Seeking supplies the goal, exertion supplies the operation, and divergence explains why apparently similar effort leads in different directions.

subchannels.name: Suitability, Readiness, and Entitlement
subchannels.scene_or_process: A participant or object is judged appropriate for a task, becomes ready, and thereby acquires priority.
subchannels.active_motifs: inherent suitability `خ ل ق:B005/m01`; fit with a person's condition `ز ك و:B004/m01`; propriety or feasibility `ب غ ي:B002/m01`; readiness `ء ت ي:B003/m04`; entitlement or worthiness `و ل ي:B008/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Suitability relates capacity to task, readiness marks entry into action, and entitlement names the priority that follows from fit.

subchannels.name: Ease, Hardship, and Obstruction
subchannels.scene_or_process: A course is either opened and prepared or twisted, resisted, and made arduous.
subchannels.active_motifs: opened ease and preparedness `ي س ر:B001/m01`; difficulty `ع س ر:B001/m01`; resistance and complication `ع س ر:B004/m01`; arduous sustained handling `ش ق و:B002/m02`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 92:7 and 92:10 (`ي س ر`: `نيسره`); 92:10 (`ع س ر`: `العسرى`); 92:15 (`ش ق و`: `الأشقى`)
subchannels.synthesis: Ease opens the operation, resistance twists or delays it, and hardship names the resulting burden.

subchannels.name: Yielding Form and Controlled Motion
subchannels.scene_or_process: A body or implement responds to force through softness, flexion, balanced stance, or calm movement.
subchannels.active_motifs: pliant bow or compliant mount `ع ط و:B006/m01`; agile yielding movement `ي س ر:B005/m01`; wide balanced stance `ج ن ب:B012/m01`; calm composed gait `ه د ي:B010/m01`; softness `ء ن ث:B002/m01`; hardness and cutting strength `ذ ك ر:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 92:5 (`ع ط و`: `أعطى`); 92:7 and 92:10 (`ي س ر`: `نيسره`); 92:17 (`ج ن ب`: `سيجنبها`); 92:12 (`ه د ي`: `الهدى`); 92:3 (`ء ن ث`: `الأنثى`; `ذ ك ر`: `الذكر`)
subchannels.synthesis: Softness and hardness define material poles, while stance, flexion, and gait show how form channels force.

subchannels.name: Condition, Disposition, Soundness, and Incapacity
subchannels.scene_or_process: An underlying condition or character makes a person sound and ready, weak and slow, or left without an available alternative.
subchannels.active_motifs: present condition or circumstance `ء و ل:B007/m01`; inward disposition and habitual character `خ ل ق:B004/m01`; complete soundness and fitness `ص د ق:B003/m01`; dullness or bodily weakness `ه د ي:B009/m01`; absence of any workable option `ع ن د:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Circumstance supplies the external state, disposition supplies the internal tendency, and soundness or incapacity determines whether action can proceed.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: An action succeeds or fails according to effort, suitability, readiness, ease, and the way a body or object yields to force.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 92:4 names divergent endeavor, and 92:7 and 92:10 contrast prepared ease with hardship.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Capacity extends into entitlement, pliant bows, compliant mounts, balanced stance, material hardness, and obstructed childbirth.

parent_channels.name: Transfer, Wealth, and Financial Settlement

subchannels.name: Request, Grant, and Benefaction
subchannels.scene_or_process: A need is sought, a transferable good is handed over, and the recipient enters a better condition.
subchannels.active_motifs: seeking a desired thing `ب غ ي:B001/m01`; requesting a gift `ع ط و:B005/m01`; handing over a grant `ع ط و:B002/m01`; bestowal `ء ت ي:B002/m01`; benefaction `ح س ن:B002/m03`; favor received `ن ع م:B001/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Seeking establishes need, giving transfers the object, and benefaction names the favorable change produced.

subchannels.name: Wealth, Withholding, and Claimed Independence
subchannels.scene_or_process: A holder accumulates property, restrains its circulation, and treats abundance as freedom from need.
subchannels.active_motifs: possessed wealth `م و ل:B001/m01`; withholding what should circulate `ب خ ل:B001/m01`; wealth and needlessness `غ ن ي:B001/m01`; material affluence `ي س ر:B003/m01`; financial straitness `ع س ر:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 92:11 and 92:18 (`م و ل`: `ماله`); 92:8 (`ب خ ل`: `بخل`; `غ ن ي`: `استغنى`); 92:7 and 92:10 (`ي س ر`: `نيسره`); 92:10 (`ع س ر`: `العسرى`)
subchannels.synthesis: Accumulation creates apparent capacity, withholding closes transfer, and straitness exposes its opposite.

subchannels.name: Charity, Purification, and Productive Increase
subchannels.scene_or_process: Property leaves the holder as alms, purifies the giver, and reappears lexically as growth and yield.
subchannels.active_motifs: charitable transfer `ص د ق:B006/m01`; obligatory alms `ص د ق:B006/m02`; purification `ز ك و:B002/m01`; organic increase `ز ك و:B001/m01`; emerging produce `ء ت ي:B007/m01`; reverent self-protection `و ق ي:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 92:6 (`ص د ق`: `صدق`); 92:18 (`ز ك و`: `يتزكى`; `ء ت ي`: `يؤتي`); 92:5 and 92:17 (`و ق ي`: `اتقى`, `الأتقى`)
subchannels.synthesis: Redistribution removes private possession, purification describes its effect, and growth recasts subtraction as productive increase.

subchannels.name: Recompense, Sufficiency, and Substitution
subchannels.scene_or_process: An act is answered by an equivalent return, or one payment or person stands in for another and discharges the claim.
subchannels.active_motifs: recompense for an act `ج ز ي:B001/m01`; substitute that suffices `ج ز ي:B002/m01`; charity discharging its owner `ج ز ي:B002/m03`; utility and sufficiency `غ ن ي:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Recompense matches an earlier act, while sufficiency and substitution close an obligation without reproducing the original object.

subchannels.name: Debt, Levy, Resale, and Monetary Unit
subchannels.scene_or_process: A quantified obligation is collected, paid as tax, or transferred through a deferred resale.
subchannels.active_motifs: collecting a debt `ج ز ي:B003/m01`; demand pressed against an insolvent debtor `ع س ر:B003/m01`; imposed levy `ج ز ي:B004/m01`; tribute paid `ء ت ي:B008/m01`; resale at a known price `و ل ي:B014/m01`; fixed monetary weight `و ق ي:B004/m01`; deferment `ء خ ر:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Debt and levy define what is due, the monetary unit measures it, and resale or deferment governs when and to whom it passes.

subchannels.name: Redemption Labor and Manumission
subchannels.scene_or_process: An enslaved person works toward a fixed price so accumulated value can substitute for bondage and secure release.
subchannels.active_motifs: labor toward the price of freedom `س ع ي:B005/m01`; monetary means `م و ل:B001/m01`; payment discharging a condition `ج ز ي:B002/m01`; transferred grant `ع ط و:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Labor produces the price, property carries it, transfer makes it available, and substitution converts payment into release.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Value moves or stops moving through request, grant, possession, charity, substitution, repayment, levy, and release.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 92:5 gives, 92:8 withholds and claims independence, 92:11 tests wealth's utility, and 92:18-19 join wealth, purification, favor, and recompense.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Exchange reaches debt collection, tribute, resale, fixed weights, ransom labor, and payment that substitutes for another condition.

parent_channels.name: Promise, Record, and Binding Obligation

subchannels.name: Promise, Fulfillment, and Vow
subchannels.scene_or_process: A commitment is declared, made binding, and realized in the act that fulfills it.
subchannels.active_motifs: fulfillment of promise `ص د ق:B004/m02`; self-imposed vow `ن ذ ر:B002/m01`; verbal affirmation `ن ع م:B004/m01`; binding injunction `ك ذ ب:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Declaration creates the commitment, vow or injunction binds it, and fulfillment makes it effective in action.

subchannels.name: Certificate, Claim, and Evidentiary Record
subchannels.scene_or_process: A claim is fixed in a document and preserved as a reference for truth, debt, or entitlement.
subchannels.active_motifs: title deed or certificate of right `ذ ك ر:B008/m01`; truthful statement `ص د ق:B001/m01`; debt claim `ج ز ي:B003/m01`; entitlement `و ل ي:B008/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The document preserves the claim, truthful statement supplies its asserted content, and entitlement defines the right it records.

subchannels.name: Pact, Surety, and Protected Alliance
subchannels.scene_or_process: Parties establish a durable relation through pact, guaranty, patronage, and loyal aid.
subchannels.active_motifs: pact and covenant `ر ب ب:B011/m01`; guarantor or obedient loyal party `ر ض و:B006/m01`; obedient, loving, or guaranteeing trusted person `ر ض ي:B004/m01`; legal patronage `و ل ي:B005/m01`; protected person under a pledge `ه د ي:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Pact defines the bond, surety secures performance, patronage gives it standing, and loyalty sustains it.

subchannels.name: Exhortation, Adherence, and Urging
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker directs another person toward an act by urging him to take hold of it and treat it as binding.
subchannels.active_motifs: idiomatic injunction to adhere `ك ذ ب:B003/m01`; exhortation to take or hold `ع ن د:B006/m01`; summons to come `ع ل و:B006/m01`; spoken declaration `ذ ك ر:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Declaration names the duty, exhortation puts it before the hearer, and the summons turns obligation into directed action.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A verbal or written commitment binds participants by promise, vow, record, surety, pact, or injunction.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 92:6 enacts affirmation, 92:14 warns, and 92:19 frames a claim that is not being repaid.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Obligation includes a title deed, assessed surety, self-imposed vow, protected alliance, and idiomatic commands to adhere.

parent_channels.name: Hazard, Protection, and Ruin

subchannels.name: Warning, Vigilance, and Protective Barrier
subchannels.scene_or_process: Notice of danger awakens caution, after which a person interposes a barrier, withdraws, or is moved beyond the threatened area.
subchannels.active_motifs: danger-warning `ن ذ ر:B001/m01`; protective barrier `و ق ي:B001/m01`; self-protective caution `و ق ي:B002/m01`; removal from harm `ج ن ب:B003/m01`; side-shield `ج ن ب:B011/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 92:14 (`ن ذ ر`: `أنذرتكم`); 92:5 and 92:17 (`و ق ي`: `اتقى`, `الأتقى`); 92:17 (`ج ن ب`: `سيجنبها`)
subchannels.synthesis: Warning makes the hazard known, caution changes conduct, and withdrawal or a physical shield prevents contact with the harmful force.

subchannels.name: Ignition, Flame, and Scorching Exposure
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fire is kindled, rises as a pure flame, and becomes an environment whose heat is entered or endured.
subchannels.active_motifs: kindled fire and branding flame `ن و ر:B002/m01`; pure rising flame `ل ظ ي:B001/m01`; named consuming fire `ل ظ ي:B002/m01`; entering and suffering fire `ص ل ي:B003/m01`; severe heat `ل ظ ي:B004/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 92:14 (`ن و ر`: `نارا`; `ل ظ ي`: `تلظى`); 92:15 (`ص ل ي`: `يصلاها`)
subchannels.synthesis: Ignition supplies the fire, flame names its active form, and exposure completes the sequence as direct bodily encounter with destructive heat.

subchannels.name: Cooking, Cautery, and Heat-Straightening
subchannels.scene_or_process: Controlled heat transforms a material by roasting it, marking it, or making a bent implement straight and usable.
subchannels.active_motifs: fire used for roasting and straightening `ص ل ي:B004/m01`; fire-branding of livestock `ن و ر:B002/m02`; intense working heat `ل ظ ي:B004/m02`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 92:14 (`ن و ر`: `نارا`; `ل ظ ي`: `تلظى`); 92:15 (`ص ل ي`: `يصلاها`)
subchannels.synthesis: Heat is not only destructive: under control it cooks, brands, and corrects form by changing material through sustained exposure.

subchannels.name: Fall, Affliction, and Bodily Collapse
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person or possession is overtaken by calamity, loses stability, and descends into illness, breakage, disappearance, or death.
subchannels.active_motifs: falling into a pit or ruin `ر د ي:B003/m01`; arrival of illness or destruction `ء ت ي:B011/m01`; pleuritic side-affliction `ج ن ب:B007/m01`; internal disease that overtakes the body `غ ش ي:B003/m01`; swoon or loss of awareness `غ ش و:B005/m01`, `غ ش ي:B007/m01`; misery and sustained suffering `ش ق و:B002/m01`, `ش ق ي:B001/m01`, `ش ق ي:B002/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Calamity arrives, bodily integrity or footing fails, and the resulting descent ranges from localized pain to terminal ruin.

subchannels.name: Wound, Assessment, and Restitution
subchannels.scene_or_process: A bodily wound creates a measurable liability that must be assessed and discharged through compensation.
subchannels.active_motifs: wound swelling or progressing toward corruption `ب غ ي:B004/m01`; unstaunched lateral blood-flow `ع ن د:B003/m01`; injury carrying a fixed indemnity `ن ذ ر:B003/m01`; recompense for an incurred act `ج ز ي:B001/m02`; measured equivalence `خ ل ق:B001/m03`; payment that settles a claim `ج ز ي:B003/m02`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 92:20 (`ب غ ي`: `ابتغاء`); 92:19 (`ع ن د`: `عنده`; `ج ز ي`: `تجزى`); 92:14 (`ن ذ ر`: `أنذرتكم`); 92:3 (`خ ل ق`: `خلق`)
subchannels.synthesis: Injury is converted into an obligation by assessment, and equivalence turns bodily loss into a compensable legal amount.

subchannels.name: Blow, Projectile, and Forceful Impact
subchannels.scene_or_process: An attacker directs force through a blow or thrown stone, producing fracture, displacement, or defensive response.
subchannels.active_motifs: stone thrown to strike or break `ر د ي:B001/m01`; side blow causing bodily injury `ج ن ب:B007/m02`; lash or sword laid upon a person `غ ش و:B006/m01`, `غ ش ي:B006/m01`; violent overtaking `ء ت ي:B011/m02`; defensive interposition `و ق ي:B001/m02`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 92:11 (`ر د ي`: `تردى`); 92:17 (`ج ن ب`: `سيجنبها`; `و ق ي`: `الأتقى`); 92:1 (`غ ش و`: `يغشى`); 92:18 (`ء ت ي`: `يؤتي`)
subchannels.synthesis: Projectile and blow are concrete delivery mechanisms of harm, while overtaking names their force and protection supplies the opposed response.

subchannels.name: Fury and Violent Outbreak
subchannels.scene_or_process: Anger heats inwardly, breaks into aggressive conduct, and culminates in a blow delivered by hand, whip, or sword.
subchannels.active_motifs: anger figured as blazing heat `ل ظ ي:B003/m01`; aggressive transgression `ب غ ي:B003/m02`; lash or sword-strike `غ ش و:B006/m02`, `غ ش ي:B006/m02`; presumptuous violent undertaking `ع ط و:B004/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Heat supplies the shape of rage, transgression removes restraint, and the strike turns inward fury into an outward harmful event.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A threatening force becomes perceptible, is met by protective action, or proceeds into injury, destruction, and compensable loss.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 92:14-17 joins warning, blazing fire, exposure, and avoidance, while 92:11 names a terminal fall.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same field reaches a side-shield, hoof-protecting gait, cautery, cooking fire, a wound tariff, pleurisy, and the straightening of wood by heat.

parent_channels.name: Reproduction, Marriage, and Household Formation

subchannels.name: Sexed Creation and Pair Formation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Living beings are differentiated as male and female and brought into a reproductive pairing.
subchannels.active_motifs: creative bringing-into-being `خ ل ق:B002/m01`; completed bodily formation `خ ل ق:B003/m03`; male sex and masculine member `ذ ك ر:B001/m01`; female sex and reproductive femininity `ء ن ث:B001/m01`; mating or sexual covering `غ ش و:B004/m01`, `غ ش ي:B004/m01`; female animal seeking the male `ء ت ي:B012/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 92:3 (`خ ل ق`: `خلق`; `ذ ك ر`: `الذكر`; `ء ن ث`: `الأنثى`); 92:1 (`غ ش و`: `يغشى`); 92:18 (`ء ت ي`: `يؤتي`)
subchannels.synthesis: Sex differentiation supplies the pair, desire brings the animals or persons together, and covering expresses the reproductive union.

subchannels.name: Pregnancy, Delivery, and Postpartum Recovery
subchannels.scene_or_process: Conception proceeds through difficult labor, bodily opening and presentation, then recovery after birth.
subchannels.active_motifs: sexual union `غ ش و:B004/m02`; obstructed or difficult delivery `ع س ر:B006/m01`; hands-first fetal presentation `و ج ه:B010/m01`; birth opening beside the tail `ص ل ي:B006/m01`; rising after childbirth `ع ل و:B011/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 92:1 (`غ ش و`: `يغشى`); 92:10 (`ع س ر`: `العسرى`); 92:20 (`و ج ه`: `وجه`; `ع ل و`: `الأعلى`); 92:15 (`ص ل ي`: `يصلاها`)
subchannels.synthesis: Union initiates reproduction, difficult presentation and bodily opening define the delivery crisis, and rising afterward marks restoration.

subchannels.name: Bride, Dowry, and Wedding Transfer
subchannels.scene_or_process: A bride is adorned and led into a new household while gifts and an agreed marital payment formalize the union.
subchannels.active_motifs: unveiled and adorned bride `ج ل و:B003/m01`; bride-unveiling gift `ج ل و:B009/m01`; bride conducted to her husband `ه د ي:B006/m01`; marriage as protection and sufficiency `غ ن ي:B006/m01`; woman made sufficient by marriage or beauty `غ ن ي:B005/m03`; bridal payment `ص د ق:B007/m01`; bestowed gift `ع ط و:B002/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Adornment makes the bride publicly legible, guidance conducts her between households, and dowry and gift complete the social transfer.

subchannels.name: Lineage, Stepchildren, and Domestic Nurture
subchannels.scene_or_process: A household identifies descent, incorporates dependents, and raises children under sustained care and authority.
subchannels.active_motifs: kin and household dependents `ء و ل:B003/m01`; stepchild under a guardian's care `ر ب ب:B005/m01`; legal family patronage `و ل ي:B005/m02`; rearing and corrective nurture `ر ب ب:B002/m01`; remembered lineage `ذ ك ر:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Descent locates the child, patronage establishes belonging, and repeated nurture turns kinship into a functioning household relation.

subchannels.name: Milk, Offspring, and Household Increase
subchannels.scene_or_process: Successful reproduction appears as abundant offspring, renewed milk, and the productive sufficiency of the herd-dependent home.
subchannels.active_motifs: easy increase of milk and offspring `ي س ر:B006/m01`; productive livestock wealth `ن ع م:B005/m01`; new mother or newly productive ewe `ر ب ب:B009/m01`; material sufficiency `غ ن ي:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Birth creates the new animal, lactation converts reproduction into nourishment, and herd increase becomes household sufficiency.

subchannels.name: Sexual Coercion and Exploitative Gain
subchannels.scene_or_process: Authority turns sexual access into compelled labor and extracts income from another person's body.
subchannels.active_motifs: coercive sexual transgression `ب غ ي:B005/m01`; broker who imposes a sexual levy `س ع ي:B007/m01`; compelled sexual covering `غ ش و:B004/m03`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 92:20 (`ب غ ي`: `ابتغاء`); 92:4 (`س ع ي`: `سعيكم`); 92:1 (`غ ش و`: `يغشى`)
subchannels.synthesis: Sexual union is recast as an imposed transaction: coercion supplies control, brokerage organizes the act, and extracted gain identifies its exploitative outcome.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Biological pairing and social transfer create offspring, spouses, lineage, and the domestic relations that sustain them.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 92:3 names creation of male and female, while 92:5, 92:18, and 92:20 supply giving, transfer, and lordly nurture.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The field includes estrus, difficult delivery, the opening at the tail during birth, bride-unveiling, dowry, stepchildren, milk increase, and coerced sexual commerce.

parent_channels.name: Presence, Settlement, and Dispersal

subchannels.name: Nearness, Side-by-Side Presence, and Attendance
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person stands in another's presence or alongside a companion, establishing proximity without yet implying kinship or ownership.
subchannels.active_motifs: presence and possession at one's side `ع ن د:B004/m01`; nearness beside a companion `ج ن ب:B002/m01`; facing presence `و ج ه:B003/m01`; person placed next to another `و ل ي:B001/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Side, face, and immediate placement give three spatial descriptions of attendance, turning abstract relation into embodied proximity.

subchannels.name: Arrival, Visitation, and Residence
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveler arrives, enters a settled place, becomes a guest or resident, and receives the provisions associated with staying.
subchannels.active_motifs: arrival and coming `ء ت ي:B001/m01`; entry from abroad `ء ت ي:B006/m01`; visitation or repeated attendance `غ ش و:B003/m01`, `غ ش ي:B005/m01`; pleasant settled dwelling `ن ع م:B011/m01`; residence that removes need `غ ن ي:B004/m01`; household lodging and care `ر ب ب:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Coming becomes residence when the entrant is received, lodged, and provisioned, transforming a passing stranger into a situated member or guest.

subchannels.name: Migration, Weaning, and Dispersal
subchannels.scene_or_process: A formerly gathered unit separates as a person departs, a child is weaned, or a people scatter into distinct locations.
subchannels.active_motifs: scattering into separate groups `ش ت ت:B001/m01`; individual separation from a collective `ء ح د:B005/m01`; weaning and withdrawal from nursing `ن ع م:B008/m01`; difficult departure or forced removal `ع س ر:B011/m01`; open departure into view `ج ل و:B004/m01`; young livestock separated from their mothers `و ل ي:B015/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Weaning provides the intimate model of separation, departure enacts it spatially, and scattering scales the same transition from one person to an entire group.

subchannels.name: Stranger, Neighbor, and Household Boundary
subchannels.scene_or_process: A community distinguishes the nearby outsider from kin and negotiates whether that person remains foreign, becomes a neighbor, or enters the household.
subchannels.active_motifs: stranger outside lineage or home `ج ن ب:B003/m02`; entrant from another people `ء ت ي:B006/m02`; side-neighbor and companion `ج ن ب:B002/m02`; household affiliation `ء و ل:B003/m02`; residence under care `ر ب ب:B007/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Foreignness is relational rather than fixed: proximity makes the outsider a neighbor, and reception or affiliation can carry that person across the domestic boundary.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Persons and groups are positioned relative to a place or one another through nearness, arrival, residence, estrangement, departure, and scattering.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 92:19 places a claim `عنده`, 92:16 turns away, and 92:20 directs purpose toward a face or presence.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Spatial relation extends to the stranger inside another people, the side-companion, a weaned child leaving the breast, a migrating household, and a crowd broken into individuals.

parent_channels.name: Weather, Water, Growth, and Pastoral Provision

subchannels.name: Rain, Wind, Cloud, and Incoming Flood
subchannels.scene_or_process: Wind and cloud carry weather across territory, rain falls, and runoff reaches a place that may not itself have received the storm.
subchannels.active_motifs: rain-bearing seeking and overflow `ب غ ي:B006/m01`; flood arriving from another region `ء ت ي:B005/m01`; cloud driven over a place `و ل ي:B010/m01`; rain-bearing cloud and downpour `ر ب ب:B008/m01`; named rain-cloud `ن ه ر:B008/m01`; soft moist southern wind `ن ع م:B009/m01`; southern wind and its cloud `ج ن ب:B006/m01`; side-driving rain or runoff `ع ن د:B003/m02`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 92:20 (`ب غ ي`: `ابتغاء`; `ر ب ب`: `ربه`); 92:18 (`ء ت ي`: `يؤتي`); 92:16 (`و ل ي`: `تولى`); 92:2 (`ن ه ر`: `النهار`); 92:19 (`ن ع م`: `نعمة`; `ع ن د`: `عنده`); 92:17 (`ج ن ب`: `سيجنبها`)
subchannels.synthesis: Mobile air carries cloud, rainfall generates runoff, and the arriving flood connects distant weather to local water supply.

subchannels.name: Stream, Basin, and Irrigation Control
subchannels.scene_or_process: Flowing water is directed through a channel into a basin, measured, released, or obstructed to regulate irrigation.
subchannels.active_motifs: flowing stream or river `ن ه ر:B001/m01`; channel cut or opened for flow `ن ه ر:B003/m01`; watercourse guided into a basin `ء ت ي:B004/m01`; constructed irrigation channel `خ ل ق:B011/m01`; abundant collected water `ر ب ب:B013/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The stream supplies moving water, the cut channel gives it a route, and basin control turns natural flow into a managed agricultural mechanism.

subchannels.name: Rootstock, Blossom, and Vegetative Renewal
subchannels.scene_or_process: A persistent rootstock survives adverse conditions, sends out growth, flowers, and renews the plant's visible life.
subchannels.active_motifs: plant with enduring root `ج ن ب:B010/m01`; fertile root and branching growth `ر ب ب:B012/m01`; tree blossom `ن و ر:B004/m01`; camel-fodder plant in bloom `ص ل ي:B010/m01`; thriving and purified growth `ز ك و:B001/m01`; female or fruit-bearing plant `ء ن ث:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Durable root and fertile stock carry life through dormancy, blossom makes renewal visible, and thriving growth becomes the plant's completed state.

subchannels.name: Yield, Harvest, and Productive Increase
subchannels.scene_or_process: Cultivated growth matures into fruit, grain, or another return that can be gathered and treated as increase.
subchannels.active_motifs: crop and palm yield `ء ت ي:B007/m01`; growth that becomes abundant `ز ك و:B001/m02`; soil prepared beneath a gourd or melon `و ج ه:B012/m01`; successful acquisition of the sought return `ب غ ي:B001/m02`; beneficent provision `ن ع م:B001/m02`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 92:18 (`ء ت ي`: `يؤتي`; `ز ك و`: `يتزكى`); 92:20 (`و ج ه`: `وجه`; `ب غ ي`: `ابتغاء`); 92:19 (`ن ع م`: `نعمة`)
subchannels.synthesis: Cultivation channels growth toward a sought return, harvest makes that return available, and increase gives the yield its economic and beneficent value.

subchannels.name: Herd, Milk, and Subsistence
subchannels.scene_or_process: Herd animals graze, reproduce, give milk, and become a store of nourishment and wealth for their keepers.
subchannels.active_motifs: livestock as provision and property `ن ع م:B005/m02`; herd management and animal keeping `ر ب ب:B014/m01`; lactating abundance `ي س ر:B006/m02`; freedom from need through herd wealth `غ ن ي:B001/m02`; camel-fodder pasture `ص ل ي:B010/m02`; milk or butter preparation `ك ذ ب:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Pasture sustains the herd, breeding and lactation produce food, and managed animals convert the landscape into recurring household subsistence.

subchannels.name: Scarcity, Drying, and Pastoral Dispersal
subchannels.scene_or_process: Failed pasture or a hard year reduces milk, weakens household sufficiency, and forces animals or people to disperse.
subchannels.active_motifs: year of little camel milk `ج ن ب:B008/m01`; hardship and constrained supply `ع س ر:B001/m02`; separation and scattering `ش ت ت:B001/m03`; need after lost sufficiency `غ ن ي:B001/m03`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 92:17 (`ج ن ب`: `سيجنبها`); 92:10 (`ع س ر`: `العسرى`); 92:4 (`ش ت ت`: `شتى`); 92:8 and 92:11 (`غ ن ي`: `استغنى`, `يغني`)
subchannels.synthesis: Environmental shortfall appears first in milk and provision, then in movement as the settled pastoral unit breaks apart in search of sustenance.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Atmospheric and hydraulic forces feed land, plants, and herds, converting movement of water into growth, yield, nourishment, and sometimes scarcity.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 92:1-2 supplies the night-day cycle, 92:18 names purifying increase, and 92:19 names favor and livestock provision.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The cycle includes a flood arriving from rain elsewhere, a southern wind, a channel blockage, perennial rootstock, camel fodder, curdled milk, and a year when udders go dry.

parent_channels.name: Truth, Memory, and Verbal Performance

subchannels.name: Truthful Assertion, Denial, and Fabrication
subchannels.scene_or_process: A proposition is asserted as corresponding to reality, rejected as false, or deliberately fashioned into a deceptive account.
subchannels.active_motifs: truthful statement `ص د ق:B001/m01`; false statement or act `ك ذ ب:B001/m01`; attribution of falsehood `ك ذ ب:B002/m01`; deceitful inner self `ك ذ ب:B008/m01`; fabricated discourse `خ ل ق:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Assertion offers correspondence, denial contests it, and fabrication explains how an alternative verbal world can be deliberately made.

subchannels.name: Recollection, Mention, and Reminder
subchannels.scene_or_process: Something absent from immediate awareness is retained, recalled inwardly, voiced, and made available to others as a reminder.
subchannels.active_motifs: inward recollection after forgetting `ذ ك ر:B003/m01`; spoken mention and naming `ذ ك ر:B004/m01`; object or act that prompts memory `ذ ك ر:B009/m01`; scholar who cultivates sacred knowledge `ر ب ب:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Memory moves from preservation in the mind to articulation on the tongue, while a reminder renews the subject's presence for a wider audience.

subchannels.name: Rebuke, Accusation, and Public Denunciation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker confronts another with severe words, attributes wrongdoing or falsehood, and may carry the accusation to authority.
subchannels.active_motifs: harsh verbal rebuke `ن ه ر:B004/m01`; reporting a person to a ruler `س ع ي:B004/m01`; charging another with falsehood `ك ذ ب:B002/m02`; adverse public mention `ذ ك ر:B004/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Rebuke attacks conduct directly, accusation gives the attack a propositional form, and denunciation transports it into a public or governmental forum.

subchannels.name: Praise, Honor, and Lasting Renown
subchannels.scene_or_process: Worthy action is voiced as praise and accumulates into honor, elevated rank, and remembered reputation.
subchannels.active_motifs: honorable mention and renown `ذ ك ر:B007/m01`; manifest public fame `ج ل و:B006/m01`; elevated social rank `ع ل و:B002/m01`; pursuit of noble deeds `س ع ي:B006/m01`; beauty or excellence `ح س ن:B001/m02`; acknowledged beneficence `ن ع م:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Excellence gives praise its object, noble action earns it, and repeated mention converts a momentary commendation into durable social standing.

subchannels.name: Song, Poem, Blessing, and Rhyme
subchannels.scene_or_process: Language is patterned for vocal performance, whether as song, exchanged verse, praise, satire, prayer, or metrical closure.
subchannels.active_motifs: sung and modulated voice `غ ن ي:B003/m01`; poem offered or exchanged `ه د ي:B011/m01`; rhyme orientation and closing sound `و ج ه:B011/m01`; spoken blessing and praise `ص ل ي:B002/m01`; oral recitation `ذ ك ر:B004/m03`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 92:8 and 92:11 (`غ ن ي`: `استغنى`, `يغني`); 92:12 (`ه د ي`: `الهدى`); 92:20 (`و ج ه`: `وجه`); 92:15 (`ص ل ي`: `يصلاها`); 92:3 (`ذ ك ر`: `الذكر`)
subchannels.synthesis: Voice animates the words, verse and rhyme give them form, and blessing or praise supplies the social purpose of the performance.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Speech presents, preserves, challenges, or artistically shapes what a community is asked to regard as true and memorable.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 92:3 names mention, 92:6 and 92:9 oppose truth and denial, and 92:14 performs warning.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Verbal action extends from recollection and public rebuke to reputation, sung recitation, exchanged satire, rhyme structure, and blessing.

parent_channels.name: Governance, Rank, and Collective Conflict

subchannels.name: Lordship, Stewardship, and Corrective Rule
subchannels.scene_or_process: A superior possesses responsibility for a domain, directs its affairs, and restores or develops what is under care.
subchannels.active_motifs: ownership and sovereign lordship `ر ب ب:B001/m01`; gradual repair and nurture `ر ب ب:B002/m02`; assumption of public authority `و ل ي:B003/m01`; dignitary who represents a people `و ج ه:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Lordship supplies standing, stewardship converts standing into care, and public office makes that relation operative over a household or community.

subchannels.name: Public Office, Collection, and Service
subchannels.scene_or_process: An appointed official administers a group, collects what is due, and performs the practical service attached to office.
subchannels.active_motifs: governor or public collector `س ع ي:B003/m01`; collector and distributor of alms `ص د ق:B006/m02`; attendance and household service `ع ط و:B003/m01`; delegated administration `و ل ي:B003/m02`; office grounded in precedence `ء و ل:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Appointment creates jurisdiction, service performs its daily work, and collection converts public obligation into administered resources.

subchannels.name: Captain, Vanguard, and Directed Company
subchannels.scene_or_process: A leader occupies the front or command position and directs a company through a shared course.
subchannels.active_motifs: captain of sailors `ر ب ب:B017/m01`; leader or foremost guide `ه د ي:B003/m01`; command over an undertaking `و ل ي:B003/m03`; forward rank and precedence `ء و ل:B001/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: The vanguard makes direction visible, command coordinates the company, and the captain embodies both functions in a moving collective.

subchannels.name: Scouts, Informer, and Mobilizing Alert
subchannels.scene_or_process: Advance observers detect a threat, information is carried inward, and an alarm moves the group from ignorance to readiness.
subchannels.active_motifs: scouts preceding an army `ب غ ي:B008/m01`; informer reporting to authority `س ع ي:B004/m02`; warning that awakens caution `ن ذ ر:B001/m02`; foremost guide or advance element `ه د ي:B003/m02`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 92:20 (`ب غ ي`: `ابتغاء`); 92:4 (`س ع ي`: `سعيكم`); 92:14 (`ن ذ ر`: `أنذرتكم`); 92:12 (`ه د ي`: `الهدى`)
subchannels.synthesis: Scouts acquire the information, the informer transmits it, and warning turns intelligence into collective preparation.

subchannels.name: Transgression, Arrogance, and Coercive Power
subchannels.scene_or_process: An actor exceeds a legitimate boundary, rejects correction, and uses superior position to compel others.
subchannels.active_motifs: aggressive transgression beyond right `ب غ ي:B003/m01`; obstinate rejection of truth `ع ن د:B001/m01`; arrogant elevation over others `ع ل و:B003/m01`; presumptuous seizure of what is not due `ع ط و:B004/m01`; coercive harshness `ع س ر:B008/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 92:20 (`ب غ ي`: `ابتغاء`; `ع ل و`: `الأعلى`); 92:19 (`ع ن د`: `عنده`); 92:5 (`ع ط و`: `أعطى`); 92:10 (`ع س ر`: `العسرى`)
subchannels.synthesis: Boundary crossing begins the abuse, arrogance legitimates it in the actor's own view, and coercion converts claimed superiority into force over another.

subchannels.name: Contest, Overtaking, and Dominance
subchannels.scene_or_process: Rival actors engage in the same undertaking until one surpasses the other and gains control of the object or goal.
subchannels.active_motifs: competitive striving and victory `س ع ي:B008/m01`; prevailing in reciprocal recompense `ج ز ي:B005/m01`; prevailing in a contest of taking `ع ط و:B007/m01`; victory in a contest of placation `ر ض و:B005/m01`, `ر ض ي:B002/m01`; victory through sustained struggle `ش ق و:B003/m01`, `ش ق ي:B003/m01`; reaching and possessing the goal `و ل ي:B012/m01`; overcoming and mastery `ع ل و:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Shared effort creates the contest, overtaking resolves relative position, and possession or mastery names the victor's resulting control.

subchannels.name: Charge, Courage, and Repulse
subchannels.scene_or_process: A combatant advances into contact or falters, while the opposing force receives, turns back, or strikes the charge.
subchannels.active_motifs: failed charge or cowardly halt `ك ذ ب:B004/m01`; charge made good in action `ص د ق:B004/m03`; repulse from the front `و ج ه:B014/m01`; face-level thrust `ي س ر:B009/m02`; forceful effective penetration `ء ت ي:B013/m01`; defensive barrier `و ق ي:B001/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: Courage is tested by whether advance reaches contact; penetration fulfills the charge, while repulse and protection describe the counterforce.

subchannels.name: Feud, Mediation, and Reconciliation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Hostility persists between groups until a mediator spends effort, reputation, or compensation to restore alliance.
subchannels.active_motifs: active feud and enmity `ن و ر:B007/m01`; noble effort toward peace `س ع ي:B006/m02`; friendship and mutual aid `و ل ي:B004/m01`; sincere social bond `ص د ق:B005/m02`; recompense that settles retaliation `ج ز ي:B001/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: Feud keeps injury socially active, mediation redirects competitive action toward settlement, and compensation permits hostility to become renewed alliance.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Organized groups assign authority and rank, gather intelligence, enforce or resist power, and manage escalation between rivals.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 92:20 names lordship and elevation, 92:4 names purposeful action, and 92:14 issues a public warning.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Authority includes an alms collector, household service, a ship captain, advance scouts, an informer, failed cavalry charge, feud, and blood-price conciliation.

parent_channels.name: Gait, Handling, Pursuit, and Ascent

subchannels.name: Purposeful Walking and Assisted Gait
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person or animal advances toward a goal, sometimes with a rapid walk and sometimes by leaning on companions through weakness.
subchannels.active_motifs: purposeful rapid walking `س ع ي:B001/m01`; travel on foot without a mount `ن ع م:B012/m01`; swaying walk assisted by two others `ه د ي:B008/m01`; weak heavy movement `ه د ي:B009/m02`; easy and tractable movement `ي س ر:B005/m01`; laborious or uneven walking `ع س ر:B009/m01`; bounding gait between walk and run `ر د ي:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Intention supplies the route, while ease, assistance, and uneven propulsion distinguish the bodily mechanisms by which the traveler advances.

subchannels.name: Equine Display, Stance, and Controlled Motion
subchannels.scene_or_process: A horse displays energy in its run yet remains usable through balanced stance, compliance, and composed movement.
subchannels.active_motifs: proud playful running `ب غ ي:B007/m01`; wide-set balanced legs `ج ن ب:B012/m01`; pliant response to the handler `ع ط و:B006/m01`; calm well-formed gait `ه د ي:B010/m01`; bounding or heavy-footed motion `ر د ي:B002/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Display gives the animal visible vigor, conformation stabilizes it, and compliance turns raw motion into a controlled riding gait.

subchannels.name: Camel Foreleg Return and Lateral Leading
subchannels.scene_or_process: A camel returns its forelegs rhythmically while a handler takes hold and leads it beside the body.
subchannels.active_motifs: returning camel forelegs in travel `ء ت ي:B009/m01`; taking hold by hand `ع ط و:B001/m01`; leading an animal alongside `ج ن ب:B005/m01`; deliberate animal progression `س ع ي:B001/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Foreleg return defines the animal's propulsion, hand contact establishes control, and side-leading coordinates handler and camel as one moving unit.

subchannels.name: Hoof Pain and Protective Gait
subchannels.scene_or_process: A horse senses painful ground or a tender hoof, shortens its step, and relies on careful handling or protective tack.
subchannels.active_motifs: hoof-protecting hesitation and slight lameness `و ق ي:B003/m01`; animal led beside the handler `ج ن ب:B005/m02`; calm non-panicked movement `ه د ي:B010/m02`; difficult or compromised gait `ع س ر:B009/m02`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 92:5 and 92:17 (`و ق ي`: `اتقى`, `الأتقى`); 92:17 (`ج ن ب`: `سيجنبها`); 92:12 (`ه د ي`: `الهدى`); 92:10 (`ع س ر`: `العسرى`)
subchannels.synthesis: Pain changes the step before it stops movement entirely; caution, lateral control, and composure together protect the affected hoof.

subchannels.name: Race, Second Place, and Overtaking
subchannels.scene_or_process: Racers pursue one finish, occupy ordered positions, and may overtake until one reaches the goal first and another follows at the leader's flank.
subchannels.active_motifs: competitive striving `س ع ي:B008/m02`; second racer following the winner `ص ل ي:B007/m01`; reaching and possessing the finish `و ل ي:B012/m02`; victory in reciprocal contest `ج ز ي:B005/m02`; victory in taking `ع ط و:B007/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: One course creates comparable effort, overtaking changes relative order, and the named second-place position preserves the race's embodied geometry.

subchannels.name: Mountain Ascent, Ledge, and Refuge
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveler climbs from lower ground, uses a long accessible ledge, and reaches a high place that can serve as seat or refuge.
subchannels.active_motifs: long climbable mountain ledge `ش ق و:B004/m01`, `ش ق ي:B004/m01`; physical ascent and elevation `ع ل و:B001/m01`; retreat to a mountain place `ء و ل:B009/m01`; difficult exertion `ش ق و:B002/m02`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 92:15 (`ش ق و`: `الأشقى`); 92:20 (`ع ل و`: `الأعلى`); 92:13 (`ء و ل`: `الأولى`)
subchannels.synthesis: Difficulty belongs to the climb, the ledge provides a practicable path and resting place, and elevation yields the protected destination.

subchannels.name: Hunter, Quarry, and Snare
subchannels.scene_or_process: A hunter exposes or sights quarry, gives chase, and uses a snare to arrest an animal that may run and then turn to look back.
subchannels.active_motifs: quarry brought into the open `ج ل و:B008/m01`; trap or snare set for prey `ص ل ي:B005/m01`; wild animal running then stopping `ك ذ ب:B007/m01`; taking hold of the catch `ع ط و:B001/m02`; purposeful pursuit `س ع ي:B001/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: Exposure creates sight of the quarry, pursuit closes distance, and the snare converts moving prey into a graspable catch.

subchannels.name: Throwing Game and Stone Target
subchannels.scene_or_process: Players cast stones or missiles toward a target, combining measured difficulty, projectile force, and the possibility of entrapment or a scored hit.
subchannels.active_motifs: throwing game or difficult cast `ع س ر:B013/m01`; stone projectile used to strike `ر د ي:B001/m02`; catching device or target snare `ص ل ي:B005/m02`; hand taking and casting `ع ط و:B001/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: The hand launches the stone, distance and obstruction create difficulty, and contact with target or snare resolves the throw.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Bodies and animals are distinguished by how they advance, are guided, negotiate terrain, pursue a target, or reach a positional goal.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 92:4 names directed movement, 92:7 and 92:10 contrast ease and difficulty, 92:12 names guidance, and 92:20 names elevation.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Motion includes a swaying assisted walk, camel foreleg return, lateral leading, hoof tenderness, display gait, second place in a race, mountain ledges, a hunter's trap, and a stone-throwing game.

parent_channels.name: Bodily Form, Marking, and Lifecycle

subchannels.name: Balanced Form, Stature, and Beauty
subchannels.scene_or_process: A body is shaped in proportion, presents a recognizable front, and is evaluated for stature, symmetry, and beauty.
subchannels.active_motifs: bodily formation and proportion `خ ل ق:B003/m01`; visible face and front `و ج ه:B001/m01`; beauty and excellence of form `ح س ن:B001/m03`; tall substantial stature `ع ل و:B010/m01`

subchannels.synthesis: Formation establishes the body's proportions, face gives it a public front, and stature and beauty express how the completed form is socially perceived.

subchannels.name: Head, Baldness, Facial Mark, and Blow
subchannels.scene_or_process: The head and face become identifying surfaces through exposed scalp, whitened or darkened marks, tattoo pigment, and injury.
subchannels.active_motifs: bald or uncovered scalp `ج ل و:B005/m01`; soot pigment used for tattoo or kohl `ن و ر:B008/m01`; blow delivered to the face `و ج ه:B013/m01`; face as visible bodily surface `و ج ه:B001/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Exposure makes the head legible, pigment fixes a sign on the skin, and a blow turns the same public surface into the site of injury.

subchannels.name: Paired Organs, Sides, and Body Lines
subchannels.scene_or_process: Anatomy is organized through bilateral pairs, lateral sides, and longitudinal lines that locate parts relative to the body's center.
subchannels.active_motifs: paired bodily organs `ء ن ث:B003/m01`; paired unit or twinning `ز ك و:B005/m02`; bodily side and flank `ج ن ب:B001/m01`; lengthwise body line `ي س ر:B008/m01`; back and tail-side anatomy `ص ل ي:B006/m02`

subchannels.synthesis: Pairing gives bilateral structure, side and line provide coordinates, and the back-tail region shows how those coordinates locate a concrete anatomical zone.

subchannels.name: Tooth Spacing, Smile, and Adorned Beauty

parent_channels.name: Crafted Matter, Implements, and Bearing Layers

subchannels.name: Stone Impact, Grinding, and Hard Surface
subchannels.scene_or_process: Stone is selected for density and flatness, then used as a projectile, breaking implement, grinding bed, or resistant working surface.
subchannels.active_motifs: stone cast to strike or fracture `ر د ي:B001/m03`; broad grinding slab `ص ل ي:B009/m02`; hard straight material `ص د ق:B002/m01`; smooth solid stone surface `خ ل ق:B008/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Density carries impact, breadth permits grinding, and smooth hardness makes stone a stable material for both force and preparation.

subchannels.name: Smooth Barrier, Seal, and Structural Closure
subchannels.scene_or_process: A continuous hard surface is made smooth and without opening, allowing it to seal, obstruct, or protect an enclosed space.
subchannels.active_motifs: smooth unbroken surface `خ ل ق:B008/m02`; stone-like closure without aperture `خ ل ق:B012/m01`; solid straight implement `ص د ق:B002/m02`; protective side barrier `ج ن ب:B011/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Smoothness removes gaps, solidity resists penetration, and side placement converts the material property into a functional barrier.

subchannels.name: Carrying Frame, Upper Load, and Saddle Layer
subchannels.scene_or_process: A frame or animal back receives a sequence of bearing layers, with an underlay below and an added load above.
subchannels.active_motifs: carrying frame or tent pole `ء و ل:B008/m01`; upper added burden `ع ل و:B008/m01`; saddlecloth beneath the riding gear `و ل ي:B011/m01`; shoulder garment or covering `ر د ي:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The frame or body bears the assembly, the underlayer cushions contact, and the upper addition completes a stable vertical stack.

subchannels.name: Lot Vessel, Marked Arrows, and Division
subchannels.scene_or_process: Marked arrows are gathered in a container, drawn for a game or allotment, and used to divide a slaughtered animal.
subchannels.active_motifs: leather vessel holding lot-arrows `ر ب ب:B010/m01`; gambling arrows and division of the carcass `ي س ر:B007/m01`; named elevated lot-arrow `ع ل و:B009/m01`; hand drawing or taking a lot `ع ط و:B001/m04`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 92:20 (`ر ب ب`: `ربه`; `ع ل و`: `الأعلى`); 92:7 and 92:10 (`ي س ر`: `نيسره`); 92:5 (`ع ط و`: `أعطى`)
subchannels.synthesis: The case preserves the set, the hand selects an arrow, and the mark on the lot determines how a shared carcass is apportioned.

subchannels.name: Garment, Wear, Dye, and Surface Renewal
subchannels.scene_or_process: Cloth is worn on the body, loses its nap through use, and receives dye or scent that renews its visible surface.
subchannels.active_motifs: worn cloth stripped of its nap `خ ل ق:B009/m01`; shoulder garment and sash `ر د ي:B004/m02`; feminine perfume or dye that colors cloth `ء ن ث:B007/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 92:3 (`خ ل ق`: `خلق`; `ء ن ث`: `الأنثى`); 92:11 (`ر د ي`: `تردى`)
subchannels.synthesis: Wearing degrades the fabric, while dye and scent transform the used textile and give its surface a renewed social presentation.

subchannels.name: Polishing, Pigment, Perfume, and Body Treatment
subchannels.scene_or_process: A substance is ground or prepared, then applied to metal, eye, skin, hair, or cloth to polish, color, scent, mark, or remove hair.
subchannels.active_motifs: polish and eye-clearing kohl `ج ل و:B002/m02`; soot used as kohl or tattoo pigment `ن و ر:B008/m02`; depilatory coating `ن و ر:B009/m01`; prepared perfume paste `خ ل ق:B010/m01`; feminine scent that colors cloth `ء ن ث:B007/m02`; grinding stone for aromatic material `ص ل ي:B009/m03`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 92:2 (`ج ل و`: `تجلى`); 92:14 (`ن و ر`: `نارا`); 92:3 (`خ ل ق`: `خلق`; `ء ن ث`: `الأنثى`); 92:15 (`ص ل ي`: `يصلاها`)
subchannels.synthesis: Grinding prepares the material, application changes a receiving surface, and the result ranges from clearer sight and luster to durable color, scent, or bodily alteration.

subchannels.name: Heating, Thickening, and Viscous Compound
subchannels.scene_or_process: Milk, oil residue, honey, tar, or another liquid is heated or left until it coagulates into a thick preparation used in food, medicine, or material treatment.
subchannels.active_motifs: liquid curdling at its final state `ء و ل:B005/m01`; thick syrup or prepared residue `ر ب ب:B006/m01`; heating and roasting process `ص ل ي:B004/m02`; measured preparation before action `خ ل ق:B001/m04`
subchannels.synthesis: Time and heat alter consistency, measurement controls the preparation, and thickening turns a mobile liquid into a preservable or applicable compound.

subchannels.name: Beverage Vessel and Maturation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A drink is enclosed in a vessel for several days so that time and containment improve or complete it.
subchannels.active_motifs: vessel in which drink matures `ء و ل:B010/m01`; liquid reaching a thickened or completed state `ء و ل:B005/m02`; enclosing cover `غ ش و:B001/m03`; pleasant consumption and ease `ن ع م:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The vessel fixes the liquid in place, covering protects the interval, and elapsed time changes the drink toward a valued finished state.

subchannels.name: Cord Twisting, Flexion, and Tension
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fibers are turned downward into a cord, then tension and controlled yielding make the line or bow usable.
subchannels.active_motifs: downward twisting of fibers `ي س ر:B009/m01`; smooth finished cord `خ ل ق:B008/m03`; pliant bow under force `ع ط و:B006/m04`; measured shaping before use `خ ل ق:B001/m06`
subchannels.synthesis: Twist binds separate fibers, smoothing gives the cord a continuous surface, and controlled flexion stores force without structural failure.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Raw or prepared materials are shaped, layered, contained, marked, or hardened so that they can bear, cover, divide, grind, preserve, or adorn.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 92:3 names making, 92:5 names hand transfer, 92:14-15 supplies fire, and 92:20 names upper placement and visible surface.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The field includes a grinding slab, sealed stone, bier or tent frame, saddle underlay, gaming-arrow case, deceptive textile, tattoo soot, depilatory paste, thick syrup, and a vessel for maturing drink.

parent_channels.name: Measure, Number, and Degree

subchannels.name: Estimation, Weight, and Measured Unit
subchannels.scene_or_process: Material is estimated before use and expressed through an established unit so that portions or values can be compared.
subchannels.active_motifs: prior estimation and measurement `خ ل ق:B001/m05`; fixed ounce weight `و ق ي:B004/m01`; slight measured amount `ي س ر:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 92:3 (`خ ل ق`: `خلق`); 92:5 and 92:17 (`و ق ي`: `اتقى`, `الأتقى`); 92:7 and 92:10 (`ي س ر`: `نيسره`)
subchannels.synthesis: Estimation creates a scale, the named weight stabilizes it, and small or monetary amounts become commensurable within that system.

subchannels.name: One, Pair, and Multitude
subchannels.scene_or_process: A set is distinguished as undivided one, any single member, a pair, or a gathered plurality.
subchannels.active_motifs: absolute oneness `ء ح د:B001/m02`; individual under an unrestricted negative `ء ح د:B002/m01`; single member `ء ح د:B003/m02`; paired or even unit `ز ك و:B005/m03`; gathered multitude `ر ب ب:B004/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: One names indivisibility or an individual, pairing creates the smallest relation, and multitude scales those units into a collective.

subchannels.name: Littleness, Sufficiency, and Excess
subchannels.scene_or_process: An amount is judged as slight, enough for the need, or greater than the expected measure.
subchannels.active_motifs: small amount or short duration `ي س ر:B002/m02`; sufficient replacement `غ ن ي:B002/m02`; increase beyond measure `ر د ي:B005/m01`; abundant good or evil `ج ن ب:B009/m01`; intensified addition `ن ع م:B010/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 92:7 and 92:10 (`ي س ر`: `نيسره`); 92:8 and 92:11 (`غ ن ي`: `استغنى`, `يغني`); 92:11 (`ر د ي`: `تردى`); 92:17 (`ج ن ب`: `سيجنبها`); 92:19 (`ن ع م`: `نعمة`)
subchannels.synthesis: Littleness locates the lower bound, sufficiency marks functional adequacy, and surplus names the point at which addition exceeds the ordinary measure.

subchannels.name: Utmost Effort and Intensified Action
subchannels.scene_or_process: An action is carried to its limit, with effort or repetition indicating maximal degree rather than a different kind of act.
subchannels.active_motifs: utmost exertion or limit `ح س ن:B005/m01`; intensified continuation `ن ع م:B010/m02`; excess in word or gift `ر د ي:B005/m02`; arduous sustained effort `ش ق ي:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Effort supplies the base action, continuation magnifies it, and excess marks performance carried beyond its ordinary stopping point.

subchannels.name: First-Day Naming and Day-Opening
subchannels.scene_or_process: A calendrical day is designated as the first member of a weekly sequence and is recognized through the opening face of daylight.
subchannels.active_motifs: first position and Sunday `ء ح د:B004/m01`; opening of the day `و ج ه:B007/m01`; daylight interval `ن ه ر:B002/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Ordinal naming locates Sunday within the cycle, while the opening face of day gives firstness a recurring perceptible form.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Entities and actions are rendered comparable by weight, count, sequence, amount, or intensity.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 92:3 presents a pair, 92:13 orders first and last, 92:19 negates any single claimant, and 92:21 closes with a future degree of satisfaction.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Quantification includes an ounce weight, the one-versus-pair distinction in a hand game, Sunday as first day, very small amounts, surplus beyond measure, and an idiom for utmost effort.

parent_channels.name: Naming, Grammar, and Designation

subchannels.name: Grammatical Gender and Sexed Designation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A referent is classified as masculine or feminine through lexical designation, morphological marking, and agreement.
subchannels.active_motifs: grammatical feminization of a word `ء ن ث:B005/m01`; masculine designation `ذ ك ر:B001/m03`; female designation `ء ن ث:B001/m02`; visible form that motivates classification `خ ل ق:B003/m02`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 92:3 (`ء ن ث`: `الأنثى`; `ذ ك ر`: `الذكر`; `خ ل ق`: `خلق`)
subchannels.synthesis: Biological designation supplies the semantic contrast, while morphological marking extends that contrast into the grammar of names and descriptions.

subchannels.name: Particles, Prepositions, and Scope
subchannels.scene_or_process: Function words set relation, frequency, affirmation, and the scope of reference without naming a concrete participant.
subchannels.active_motifs: particle of reduction or recurrence `ر ب ب:B015/m01`; preposition of upper relation or obligation `ع ل و:B012/m01`; locative and relational adverb `ع ن د:B004/m02`; affirmative response particle `ن ع م:B004/m02`; unrestricted individual under negation `ء ح د:B002/m02`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 92:20 (`ر ب ب`: `ربه`; `ع ل و`: `الأعلى`); 92:19 (`ع ن د`: `عنده`; `ن ع م`: `نعمة`; `ء ح د`: `أحد`)
subchannels.synthesis: The particles do not supply scene objects; they organize how often, where, under what relation, and over what range a proposition applies.

subchannels.name: Proper Names, Mountains, Places, and Peoples
subchannels.scene_or_process: Ordinary lexical material becomes fixed as the name of a person, mountain, settlement, tribe, celestial marker, or other recognized entity.
subchannels.active_motifs: Mount Uhud `ء ح د:B006/m01`; names derived from beauty for places and bodies `ح س ن:B004/m01`; named places, persons, and stars from day or river language `ن ه ر:B007/m01`; Mount Radwa and women's names `ر ض و:B007/m01`, `ر ض ي:B003/m01`; Layla and a wine epithet `ل ي ل:B004/m01`; Yusr or Yasar as place and person `ي س ر:B010/m01`; named jinn-tribe or place `ع س ر:B012/m01`; tribal designation "the two females" `ء ن ث:B008/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Descriptive words lose some compositional force when conventionalized as names, yet their source images continue to resonate with the named person, place, or group.

subchannels.name: Metonymic Title and Analogical Naming
subchannels.scene_or_process: A salient feature supplies a title for a person, object, group, or place, allowing shape, position, or reputation to stand for the whole.
subchannels.active_motifs: public figure named by manifest fame `ج ل و:B006/m01`; dignitary called the face of a people `و ج ه:B006/m02`; young man designated Yasar `ي س ر:B011/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: A conspicuous property is promoted into a label, so public visibility, bodily front, or youth becomes a compact act of social classification.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Language classifies referents and relations by gender, particle, proper name, or a descriptive label transferred from one entity to another.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 92:3 grammatically and lexically contrasts male and female, 92:19 uses the indefinite individual, and 92:20 uses relational expressions of face, lordship, and elevation.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The field includes grammatical feminization, quantification under negation, prepositional government, named mountains and tribes, a woman's name tied to night, and a youth designated Yasar.

parent_channels.name: Acceptance, Favor, and Social Bond

subchannels.name: Contentment and Abundant Satisfaction
subchannels.scene_or_process: Aversion ceases, an outcome is accepted, and satisfaction may expand into an abundant settled state.
subchannels.active_motifs: acceptance opposed to displeasure `ر ض و:B001/m01`, `ر ض ي:B001/m01`; abundant or sought satisfaction `ر ض و:B002/m01`; favorable settled condition `ن ع م:B001/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: Acceptance removes resistance, favor makes the state positively good, and abundant satisfaction describes its stable culmination.

subchannels.name: Mutual Consent, Placation, and Reconciliation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Two parties display consent, or one works to remove the other's anger until a shared settlement becomes possible.
subchannels.active_motifs: reciprocal consent `ر ض و:B003/m01`; effort to placate another `ر ض و:B004/m01`; negotiated acceptance `ر ض ي:B001/m02`; pliant yielding `ع ط و:B006/m03`; restored alliance `و ل ي:B004/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Placation addresses displeasure, mutual consent confirms that it has ended, and renewed alliance gives the agreement a durable social form.

subchannels.name: Favor, Blessing, and Eye-Delight
subchannels.scene_or_process: A benefactor confers good that improves another's condition and is received as blessing, relief, or delight.
subchannels.active_motifs: beneficent favor and good condition `ن ع م:B001/m04`; blessing and delight to the eye `ن ع م:B013/m01`; gracious act beyond strict justice `ح س ن:B002/m03`; need answered by favor `ر ب ب:B016/m01`; blessing or prayer for another `ص ل ي:B002/m02`; good or harm assigned to a recipient `و ل ي:B013/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Need opens the relation, bestowal changes the recipient's condition, and blessing or eye-delight voices the experienced value of the gift.

subchannels.name: Friendship, Gift Exchange, and Alliance
subchannels.scene_or_process: Sincere attachment is enacted through mutual gifts, aid, covenant, and repeated acts of loyalty.
subchannels.active_motifs: sincere friendship `ص د ق:B005/m03`; loving aid and alliance `و ل ي:B004/m03`; gift sent to a beloved recipient `ه د ي:B004/m01`; covenant joining allies `ر ب ب:B011/m02`; personal gift and handover `ع ط و:B002/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: Affection motivates giving, exchange makes attachment reciprocal, and alliance or covenant stabilizes friendship beyond a single generous act.

subchannels.name: Ease, Luxury, and Comfortable Sufficiency
subchannels.scene_or_process: Adequate provision softens bodily and social life until need recedes and residence becomes pleasant.
subchannels.active_motifs: softness and luxurious living `ن ع م:B002/m02`; material self-sufficiency `غ ن ي:B001/m04`; pleasant fit with a place `ن ع م:B011/m02`; satisfied acceptance `ر ض و:B001/m02`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 92:19 (`ن ع م`: `نعمة`); 92:8 and 92:11 (`غ ن ي`: `استغنى`, `يغني`); 92:21 (`ر ض و`: `يرضى`)
subchannels.synthesis: Provision removes need, softness expresses the bodily result, and contentment confirms that the condition and dwelling are experienced as enough.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Persons move from displeasure or need into accepted, beneficial, and mutually sustaining relations.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 92:19 denies repayment for a prior favor and 92:20-21 joins seeking the Lord's face with eventual satisfaction.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Acceptance includes placating an offended party, reciprocal consent, eye-delight, gift exchange, luxury, and the bestowal of either good or harm.

parent_channels.name: Worship, Offering, and Sacred Movement

subchannels.name: Prayer, Worship Place, and Sacred Direction
subchannels.scene_or_process: Worshippers orient themselves toward a designated direction and perform the standing, bowing, and prostration of obligatory prayer in a sacred place.
subchannels.active_motifs: prescribed prayer practice `ص ل ي:B001/m01`; designated places of worship `ص ل ي:B008/m01`; sacred direction and ritual course `ه د ي:B002/m02`; face turned toward a destination `و ج ه:B002/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: Direction organizes the body, the worship place organizes the assembly, and prayer turns both into a repeated devotional act.

subchannels.name: Consecrated Offering and Sacrificial Division
subchannels.scene_or_process: Livestock or property is led toward a sanctuary as an offering, slaughtered or transferred, and divided among designated participants.
subchannels.active_motifs: offering led to the sanctuary `ه د ي:B005/m01`; livestock supplied for sacrifice `ن ع م:B005/m03`; lot-arrows dividing a carcass `ي س ر:B007/m02`; vessel holding the lots `ر ب ب:B010/m02`; gift transferred in devotion `ع ط و:B002/m04`
subchannels.synthesis: Guidance brings the animal to sacred space, transfer changes its status into an offering, and division distributes the consecrated material.

subchannels.name: Pilgrimage Route and Purposeful Approach
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveler intends a sacred destination, follows a recognized public route, and performs purposeful movement within the pilgrimage.
subchannels.active_motifs: directed walking and ritual course `س ع ي:B001/m04`; gentle guidance to the route `ه د ي:B001/m02`; traveled road and meeting of routes `ء ت ي:B010/m01`; destination-oriented face `و ج ه:B002/m04`; offering accompanying the approach `ه د ي:B005/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Intention gives the movement devotional purpose, the public road makes approach possible, and guidance and offering bind travel to the sacred destination.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Devotion is embodied through oriented prayer, movement toward a sacred destination, and transfer of an offering into consecrated use.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 92:12 names guidance, 92:15 names entry into fire through a root also carrying prayer, and 92:18-20 joins giving, purification, purpose, face, and lordship.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The devotional scene includes synagogue or church, prayer posture, ritual direction, sacrificial livestock, gambling lots repurposed as a division mechanism, and the pilgrim's traveled approach.

parent_channels.name: S1. Ostrich, Speed, and Analogical Form
parent_channels.scene_or_process: The ostrich is recognized as a concrete bird, while its height, speed, leg shape, track, or distant silhouette supplies names for otherwise unrelated objects and places.
parent_channels.active_motifs: ostrich as bird `ن ع م:B006/m01`; collective departure figured through the ostrich `ن ع م:B008/m02`; objects named ostrich by shape or speed `ن ع م:B007/m02`
parent_channels.synthesis: A single vivid animal image radiates analogically: bodily shape, rapid travel, and visual outline motivate names for a well-beam, mountain canopy, foot-part, road, and celestial station.

parent_channels.name: S2. Inauspicious Day, Omen-Bird, and Foreboding
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A difficult day is interpreted as ominous, with a named bird acting as a concrete sign through which foreboding is read.
parent_channels.active_motifs: inauspicious difficult day `ع س ر:B010/m01`; shrike named as an omen-bearing bird `و ق ي:B005/m01`; anxious expectation of harm `ن ذ ر:B001/m03`
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 92:10 (`ع س ر`: `العسرى`); 92:5 and 92:17 (`و ق ي`: `اتقى`, `الأتقى`); 92:14 (`ن ذ ر`: `أنذرتكم`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Hardness colors the day as adverse, the bird gives apprehension a visible sign, and warning translates foreboding into caution.

parent_channels.name: S3. Stealthy Incursion and Sudden Taking
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A taker approaches without open confrontation, makes a swift lateral incursion, and seizes an object before resistance can form.
parent_channels.active_motifs: stealth or snatching action `ن ه ر:B006/m01`; hand seizure or taking `ع ط و:B001/m05`; quick purposeful approach `س ع ي:B001/m05`; sideward deviation from the expected line `ع ن د:B002/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Deviation conceals the approach, sudden motion reduces the interval for response, and taking completes the incursion as possession.
